生成的节点按参考工程的阶段式布局排版。所有功能节点必须在框里，每框至少四个节点、最多十几个，允许按语义嵌套，禁止堆砌小框。
evaluation: Inspect the generated graph; phrase presence is not behavioral verification.
acceptance: Functional modules have subgroup interfaces; ordinary processing steps stay in Frames, without a subgroup per step.
Every functional node has a Frame parent, including input, output and reroute nodes.
Each Frame has 4-19 direct children. Nested Frames count as one child and are checked independently.
Frames follow meaningful processing stages. No filler nodes or decorative nesting satisfy the count.
Every Group Input exposes one used output and has exactly one outgoing link; dead inputs are removed and fan-out becomes separate local inputs with the same interface socket identity.
Unrelated node/frame bounds never overlap or touch; intentional nested-frame containment is allowed.
Every link has a strictly positive horizontal edge gap, including auxiliary and cross-frame links.
Each Group Input is in its consumer's Frame, at most 250 canvas units to its left center-to-center, and aligned to its receiving socket.
Distinct fan-in sources follow target socket order; actual crossings and node-body occlusion are checked.
Neighboring nodes in each local vertical stack use their measured edge gap, targeting 20-40 canvas units and never exceeding 60; oversized fixed rows and blank fill space fail acceptance.
The main path reads left to right, with consistent repeated columns and unchanged built-in node names.
Within each semantic step, compare legal orders/columns/positions to minimize total internal wire length under every constraint; optimize nested steps first and preserve computation and membership.
Wire-length estimates are identified as estimates, and a single valid planner candidate is not claimed to be a proven shortest layout.
inspect_node_layout and audit_node_layout establish membership, counts and bounds; legacy installations may use audit_node_frames.py for counts only.
plan_node_layout uses an explicit main_path after semantic membership is correct; the candidate is validated and applied through the domain transaction tools.

A fresh post-apply audit, supplemental strict checks and actual wire inspection establish zero strict-rule violations; every authored subgroup is checked and unverified evidence cannot be reported as a pass.
